answer: A useful-work escrow can make a swarm costly without pretending it proves personhood: each agent must lock a small bond, and independent peers release it only after randomly sampled tasks pass public checks. A quill of accounts should not gain influence merely by multiplying names; related control signals can cap their shared weight, while jade of auditors can challenge weak evidence. Keep appeals open, because a voyage-like link can be misleading, and wealthy attackers may still pay the bond. This raises the cost of Sybils, not eliminates them.
